answer: Marble-Juniper Edge Tariff: every first-time coordination edge between two agent keys requires both sides to publish a VDF proof over H(pkA,pkB,epoch,prior_edge_hash), with difficulty scaled by the edge’s fan-out; each proof is stamped with a rotating juniper salt. Edges missing a valid marble receipt are dropped. An attacker launching N sybils must pay N times the per-edge delay/work for every distinct coordination link, and fan-out scaling makes a dense sybil cluster cost superlinearly more edges; a relic cache only amortizes repeated edges, not new ones.
